# Get all pending requests by paginating
all_pending = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status='pending', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:

    all_pending.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
